privacyPolicy.privacy_policy_for_fitroom_calorie_track: Privacy Policy for Fitroom: Calorie Tracker, the Fitroom App, and related services.
privacyPolicy.this_policy_explains_what_fitroom_collec: This policy explains what Fitroom collects, why we use it, when it is shared, the device permissions we request, and how you can control or permanently delete your data.
privacyPolicy.fitroom_fitroom_we_our_or_us_provides_th: Fitroom ("Fitroom," "we," "our," or "us") provides the mobile application named
privacyPolicy.the_fitroom_app_this_website_and_related: (the "Fitroom App"), this website, and related services (together, the "Service"). Fitroom operates from Tbilisi, Georgia. This Privacy Policy applies to information processed through the Service; it does not replace the privacy terms of Apple, Google, or other services you independently choose to use.
privacyPolicy.the_fitroom_app_is_a_nutrition_and_fitne: The Fitroom App is a nutrition and fitness tool, not a medical service. We treat health, nutrition, body measurement, and meal information as sensitive data and use it only to provide and improve health and fitness functionality for you. We do not use health data for advertising, marketing profiles, data brokerage, or eligibility decisions.
privacyPolicy.we_collect_information_you_provide_infor: We collect information you provide, information generated when you use the Service, limited device and diagnostic information, and information received from services you connect. The categories are described below.
privacyPolicy.email_address_account_id_sign_in_provide: Email address, account ID, sign-in provider, and name if supplied by you or your sign-in provider.
privacyPolicy.collected_when_you_create_or_access_an_a: Collected when you create or access an account using email, Sign in with Apple, or Google; used to authenticate, sync, support, and secure your account.
privacyPolicy.age_or_birth_date_sex_height_weight_and_: Age or birth date, sex, height, weight and weight history, activity level, dietary preferences, target weight, goal pace, calorie and macro targets, onboarding answers, preferences, and referral or promo information.
privacyPolicy.provided_by_you_and_used_to_calculate_an: Provided by you and used to calculate and personalize nutrition goals, display progress, and operate rewards.
privacyPolicy.meal_photos_typed_descriptions_and_corre: Meal photos, typed descriptions and correction prompts, meal times, foods, portions, calories, macros, nutrition estimates, analysis results, and feedback.
privacyPolicy.provided_or_generated_when_you_log_a_mea: Provided or generated when you log a meal; used to analyze meals, maintain your journal, calculate daily totals, and improve result quality.
privacyPolicy.daily_active_energy_burned_total_date_so: Daily Active Energy Burned total, date, source (Apple Health or Health Connect), and time zone.
privacyPolicy.read_only_after_your_optional_system_per: Read only after your optional system permission and synced to your Fitroom account to adjust or explain daily calorie progress.
privacyPolicy.store_product_and_entitlement_identifier: Store, product and entitlement identifiers, transaction identifiers, trial and renewal status, period end, price, currency, refunds, chargebacks, and restore events.
privacyPolicy.received_from_app_stores_and_subscriptio: Received from app stores and subscription administration providers to activate Fitroom Pro, restore purchases, manage plan changes, prevent fraud, and keep required financial records. We do not receive your full card number.
privacyPolicy.app_interactions_app_version_device_and_: App interactions, app version, device and operating-system details, language, coarse network information, IP address in service logs, performance traces, crash reports, error context, and a Fitroom account ID attached to crash reports after sign-in.
privacyPolicy.collected_automatically_by_our_infrastru: Collected automatically by our infrastructure, analytics, and diagnostic services to operate, protect, troubleshoot, and improve the Service.
privacyPolicy.permission_state_reminder_preferences_sc: Permission state, reminder preferences, scheduled reminder settings, and a device messaging token handled by our notification delivery provider and the operating system.
privacyPolicy.used_only_to_deliver_reminders_and_servi: Used only to deliver reminders and service notifications you allow.
privacyPolicy.waitlist_email_signup_source_a_local_wai: Waitlist email, signup source, a local waitlist-joined timestamp, messages you send us, and related request metadata.
privacyPolicy.collected_when_you_join_the_website_wait: Collected when you join the website waitlist or contact us; used to send launch information, respond, and protect the website.
privacyPolicy.we_may_create_aggregated_or_de_identifie: We may create aggregated or de-identified statistics that cannot reasonably be linked back to you. We do not attempt to re-identify that information.
privacyPolicy.protected_device_access_is_optional_the_: Protected device access is optional. The Fitroom App asks in context, and core alternatives remain available when practical. You can change permissions later in your device settings.
privacyPolicy.we_request_camera_access_so_you_can_phot: We request camera access so you can photograph a meal for analysis. Camera access is not used for continuous recording, and microphone access is not requested. You can enter a meal manually instead.
privacyPolicy.we_request_photo_library_access_so_you_c: We request photo-library access so you can choose an existing meal image. Fitroom processes only images you select for a meal; it does not build a photo library, scan unrelated photos, or use photo data for advertising. You can use the camera or manual meal entry instead.
privacyPolicy.we_request_notification_permission_to_de: We request notification permission to deliver meal, calorie, weight, and other tracking reminders, plus necessary service messages. Notifications are optional and are not required to use paid or free features. Promotional notifications, if introduced, will require an appropriate opt-in and will include an opt-out method.
privacyPolicy.health_access_is_optional_and_read_only_: Health access is optional and read-only. The Fitroom App does not request permission to write data to Apple Health or Health Connect. The system permission screen lets you approve or deny each health type.
privacyPolicy.depending_on_your_device_the_current_per: Depending on your device, the current permission request may list read access for activity, workouts, steps, distance, mobility and energy; height, weight, BMI, body composition and other body measurements; heart rate and variability, blood pressure, blood glucose, temperature, oxygen saturation, respiratory rate and other vitals; nutrition and hydration; sleep and mindfulness; and cycle or reproductive data such as menstruation, cervical mucus, ovulation, intermenstrual bleeding, and pregnancy.
privacyPolicy.what_the_current_fitroom_app_feature_act: What the current Fitroom App feature actually reads
privacyPolicy.the_app_currently_queries_and_syncs_only: The app currently queries and syncs only your daily Active Energy Burned total, its date, source, and time zone. It does not currently query or store the other health types that may appear in the system permission list. If that changes, we will update the in-app disclosure and this policy before using additional health data.
privacyPolicy.we_never_use_healthkit_or_health_connect: We never use HealthKit or Health Connect data for advertising, marketing, profiling, or data mining. We do not sell it or share it with data brokers. We share health data with a third party only as needed to provide a health or fitness feature you request, and only with the permission required by applicable law and platform rules.
privacyPolicy.if_you_choose_sign_in_with_apple_or_goog: If you choose Sign in with Apple or Google, that provider asks you to authorize the name and email information it supplies to Fitroom. Apple may let you use a private relay email. Purchasing a subscription is not a device-data permission: Apple or Google processes your payment, while Fitroom and its subscription administration provider receive the limited subscription and entitlement information described above.

privacyPolicy.process_restore_and_manage_fitroom_pro_e: process, restore, and manage Fitroom Pro entitlements;

privacyPolicy.respond_to_support_privacy_and_legal_req: respond to support, privacy, and legal requests; and
privacyPolicy.comply_with_law_enforce_our_terms_and_pr: comply with law, enforce our terms, and protect users, Fitroom, and others.
privacyPolicy.where_applicable_law_requires_a_legal_ba: Where applicable law requires a legal basis, we rely on performance of our contract with you, your consent (especially for protected permissions and optional communications), our legitimate interests in operating and securing the Service, and compliance with legal obligations. You may withdraw consent at any time, without affecting processing that occurred before withdrawal.
privacyPolicy.the_fitroom_app_uses_third_party_artific: The Fitroom App uses third-party artificial intelligence to recognize foods and estimate portions and nutrition. When you intentionally submit a meal photo, meal description, or correction request to an AI feature, the submitted content, relevant meal context, a request identifier, and a pseudonymous user identifier are transmitted to our AI processing providers. They return an analysis to Fitroom.
privacyPolicy.we_use_this_data_only_to_perform_the_fea: We use this data only to perform the feature you requested, protect the service, measure technical cost and reliability, and improve health and fitness functionality. We do not permit AI providers to use your health or meal content for targeted advertising or data brokerage. Do not include faces, documents, medical records, or other unnecessary personal information in meal photos or prompts.
privacyPolicy.ai_results_are_estimates_and_may_be_inco: AI results are estimates and may be incomplete or wrong. They should not be used to diagnose, treat, or manage a medical condition, food allergy, or eating disorder.
privacyPolicy.we_do_not_sell_or_rent_personal_informat: We do not sell or rent personal information. We disclose only the information reasonably needed for the purposes described here:
privacyPolicy.support_account_authentication_databases: support account authentication, databases, file storage, hosting, security, and server operations.
privacyPolicy.process_the_meal_content_and_relevant_co: process the meal content and relevant context you intentionally submit to AI features.
privacyPolicy.process_limited_app_usage_crash_performa: process limited app usage, crash, performance, and diagnostic information so we can maintain and improve the Service.
privacyPolicy.process_purchases_renewals_cancellations: process purchases, renewals, cancellations, refunds, restores, and entitlement status.
privacyPolicy.process_authentication_information_when_: process authentication information when you choose a third-party sign-in option.
privacyPolicy.host_and_protect_the_website_administer_: host and protect the website, administer waitlist submissions, and deliver requested service communications.
privacyPolicy.may_receive_information_when_reasonably_: may receive information when reasonably necessary to comply with law, protect rights and safety, investigate fraud, or complete a corporate transaction subject to appropriate safeguards.
privacyPolicy.we_require_service_providers_that_proces: We require service providers that process personal data for us to use appropriate security and confidentiality protections, process data only for authorized purposes, and provide protection consistent with this policy and applicable platform requirements. Providers may retain limited records where their law or platform obligations require it.
privacyPolicy.the_fitroom_app_does_not_display_third_p: The Fitroom App does not display third-party advertising. Fitroom does not sell personal data or use health, fitness, meal-photo, camera, or photo-library data for advertising or marketing profiles. The iOS app does not request App Tracking Transparency permission and is not intended to track your activity across other companies' apps or websites.
privacyPolicy.we_use_general_app_analytics_and_perform: We use general app analytics and performance data to understand feature use and reliability. These technical services must not use health data from the Fitroom App for advertising or cross-service tracking.
privacyPolicy.we_keep_account_profile_goal_meal_photo_: We keep account, profile, goal, meal, photo, connected-health, and preference data while your account is active and as needed to provide the Service. Diagnostic, security, AI execution, and support records are kept only as long as reasonably needed for their stated purpose. Website waitlist information is retained until launch communications are complete, you opt out, or you request deletion.
privacyPolicy.you_can_initiate_deletion_at_any_time_in: You can initiate deletion at any time in the app under

privacyPolicy.account_deletion_is_permanent_not_a_temp: . Account deletion is permanent, not a temporary deactivation. We immediately block access to the account and remove its data from active use, then permanently delete or irreversibly de-identify the associated profile, onboarding, goals, measurements, weight logs, meal records, meal photos, AI requests and results, feedback, connected-health data, and notification preferences from our production systems. Deletion from routine backups and processor systems may take up to 30 days.
privacyPolicy.we_may_retain_only_information_that_we_a: We may retain only information that we are legally required or have a compelling security need to keep, such as limited subscription, transaction, tax, fraud-prevention, dispute, and deletion records. Retained data is isolated, access-restricted, not restored to the Service, and not used for marketing or profiling. When the retention reason ends, we permanently delete or de-identify it.
privacyPolicy.subscriptions_are_separate_from_account_: Subscriptions are separate from account deletion
privacyPolicy.deleting_the_fitroom_app_does_not_cancel: Deleting the Fitroom App does not cancel an auto-renewable subscription billed by Apple or Google. Cancel first through Profile → Manage subscriptions or your store account settings. Deletion remains available immediately even if you choose not to cancel.
privacyPolicy.review_and_update_profile_and_goal_infor: review and update profile and goal information in the app, or delete the account from Profile.

privacyPolicy.change_access_in_health_connect_under_ap: change access in Health Connect under App permissions → Fitroom.
privacyPolicy.change_access_in_ios_or_android_settings: change access in iOS or Android Settings. You can also disable individual reminder schedules in the Fitroom App.
privacyPolicy.manage_connected_access_through_your_app: manage connected access through your Apple or Google account settings and delete your Fitroom account to end Fitroom access.
privacyPolicy.contact_us_to_opt_out_or_delete_your_ema: contact us to opt out or delete your email. Service and privacy replies may still be sent when necessary.
privacyPolicy.withdrawing_an_optional_permission_does_: Withdrawing an optional permission does not delete data already synced to your Fitroom account. Use in-app account deletion or contact us if you also want that stored data deleted.
privacyPolicy.we_use_reasonable_administrative_technic: We use reasonable administrative, technical, and organizational measures designed to protect information, including authenticated access, encrypted network transport, access controls, and restricted production permissions. No system is completely secure, so we cannot guarantee absolute security. Protect your device, store account, and email account, and notify us if you suspect unauthorized access.
privacyPolicy.fitroom_and_its_providers_may_process_in: Fitroom and its providers may process information in Georgia, the United States, the European Economic Area, and other countries where they operate. Where required, we use contractual or other recognized safeguards for international transfers.
privacyPolicy.the_fitroom_app_is_not_intended_for_chil: The Fitroom App is not intended for children under 16, and we do not knowingly collect their personal information. Users aged 16 or 17, or below the age of legal majority where they live, should use the Service only with permission and supervision from a parent or legal guardian. Nutrition estimates for teenagers are informational and do not replace guidance from a qualified healthcare professional.
privacyPolicy.if_you_believe_a_child_under_16_has_prov: If you believe a child under 16 has provided information, contact us so we can investigate and permanently delete it.
privacyPolicy.depending_on_where_you_live_you_may_have: Depending on where you live, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, restrict, object to, or receive a portable copy of personal information; withdraw consent; and appeal or complain to a data protection authority. You will not be discriminated against for exercising a privacy right.
privacyPolicy.we_may_ask_for_information_reasonably_ne: . We may ask for information reasonably necessary to verify that the request concerns your account. Authorized agents may be required to show written authority. We will respond within the period required by applicable law.
privacyPolicy.we_may_update_this_policy_as_the_service: We may update this policy as the Service, providers, or law changes. We will post the revised policy here and update the date above. If a change materially affects how we use sensitive data, we will provide additional notice and obtain consent where required before the new use begins.
